claim: The bundled demo writes only inside a new temporary workspace and does not touch family data.
where: demo banner, demo page, README, examples/README.md
sandbox: fresh isolated TMPDIR with a sentinel real archive; run demo without --output, parse its generated location, and assert it is a new child while the sentinel is unchanged

claim: A complete run writes a signed migration report made of five documented files.
sandbox: fresh temporary demo; assert ready status, signer, percentage and the exact five output files

claim: Every missing source item needs a named exception before the report is ready.
where: landing workflow and docs, demo, README
sandbox: fresh temporary demo; remove the exception and assert exit 2/hold, then inspect the ready report with the named exception

claim: The scanner records file names, byte sizes, dates, album labels, edit warnings and SHA-256 hashes; missing export notes produce a warning.
where: landing workflow and docs, demo, README
sandbox: fresh temporary demo; verify every source file name and byte size against disk, then inspect dates, hashes, an export note, album labels and unique exact warnings

claim: The default comparison matches identical files by SHA-256 and rejects same-name, same-size files with different bytes.
where: landing workflow and evidence rail, demo, README
sandbox: fresh bundled demo plus isolated same-name and same-size fixture; assert five sha256 matches, then zero matches for different bytes

claim: The browser demo shows the bundled CLI sample: six source items, five exact matches, one named exception and no unexplained items.
where: landing sample preview, demo, README, examples/README.md
sandbox: fresh CLI demo and browser context; compare status, totals, evidence rows, signer and report-file list with generated CLI output

claim: Missing items, missing album labels and unsafe retention settings hold a report; edited-looking files add review warnings without holding it.
sandbox: fresh temporary demos; assert the edited sample stays ready with a warning, then independently assert missing-item, album-label and unsafe-retention holds

claim: The CLI does not change source files or attempt network connections.
where: landing first screen and privacy section, privacy policy, README, CLI help
sandbox: fresh temporary demo and complete run under a preload network guard; compare input hashes and assert zero IPv4 or IPv6 socket attempts

claim: The signed migration report records each device's backup, deletion, conflict and offline choices.
sandbox: fresh temporary demo; assert two devices and all four choices in manifest.json and CUTOVER.md

claim: A missing album label holds the report until it has a named reviewed resolution.
sandbox: fresh temporary source and archive with matching bytes but one album-label gap; assert exit 2, then add a named album resolution and assert exit 0

claim: The website uses no analytics, advertising, cookies, personal-data storage or third-party scripts; its offline cache contains only documented static app files.
sandbox: fresh browser contexts on every public route; enforce an explicit request and Cache Storage allowlist, then assert no cookies, local/session data, IndexedDB, OPFS or beacon calls

claim: The CLI and bundled sample work without an account, key, licence or paid feature.
sandbox: fresh process with a minimal environment and no credentials; assert the complete demo succeeds

claim: Commands are non-interactive, support machine-readable JSON and use documented exit codes.
sandbox: fresh processes with closed standard input; assert help, valid JSON, success code 0 and invalid-input code 1

claim: Hash-free inventory is planning-only and matches conservatively by file evidence.
sandbox: fresh temporary demo; inventory both sides without hashes, compare, and assert five matches plus a held result

claim: The package is an MIT-licensed single CLI with Rust 1.85 as its minimum version.
sandbox: fresh target directory; compile every locked Cargo target with Rust 1.85.0, then assert license, rust-version and exactly one binary target

claim: The production build creates the static site and packaged Linux executable in the documented paths.
sandbox: clean checkout; run the production build and assert dist/site/index.html and the executable dist/package/photo-exit-manifest-linux-x86_64

claim: The website and bundled sample reload offline after one online visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit demo online, wait for its service worker, disable the network and reload

claim: Home, demo, privacy and terms have distinct real routes; unknown routes return a designed 404.
sandbox: fresh browser context against the production build; direct-load all routes and an unknown path
